'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Libyan Crisis (2011–present)|Libyan Crisis]]
**The [[African Union]] announces the organization of a [[peace conference]] to address the instability in [[Libya]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230219-au-says-to-organise-libya-reconciliation-conference (AFP via France 24)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[76th British Academy Film Awards]]
**The 76th [[British Academy Film Awards]] are held in [[London]], with the [[Cinema of Germany|German film]] ''[[All Quiet on the Western Front (2022 film)|All Quiet on the Western Front]]'' winning the most awards with seven, including [[BAFTA Award for Best Film|Best Film]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-64510093 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[February 2023 Kallar Kahar bus accident|2023 Kallar Kahar bus accident]]
**Fourteen people are killed and 63 others are injured when a [[bus crash]]es and overturns near [[Kallar Kahar]], [[Chakwal District]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/automotive-accidents-shahbaz-sharif-pakistan-c36ab9e8596c47e2a30e561c4e71383a (AP)]
*[[2023 São Paulo floods and landslides]]
**At least 43 people are killed in [[São Sebastião, São Paulo|São Sebastião]] and another person is killed in [[Ubatuba]] during [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/20/floods-landslides-kill-dozens-in-brazils-sao-paulo-state (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Six people are killed, including the vice mayor of [[Aparri]], [[Cagayan]], [[Philippines]], when their car is [[ambush]]ed in [[Bagabag, Nueva Vizcaya|Bagabag]], [[Nueva Vizcaya]], by unknown gunmen. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1732023/aparri-vice-mayor-5-others-killed-in-nueva-vizcaya-ambush/ (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Bangladeshi presidential election]]
**[[Shahabuddin Chuppu]], of the ruling [[Awami League]], is elected by the [[Jatiya Sangsad]] as the new [[President of Bangladesh|president of Bangladesh]], succeeding [[Mohammad Abdul Hamid]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/shahabuddin-chuppu-elected-as-bangladesh-s-new-president-101676372642719.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Sports'''

**[[Ricky Stenhouse Jr.]] wins the 65th running of the [[2023 Daytona 500|Daytona 500]]. [https://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/story/_/id/35698155/ricky-stenhouse-jr-wins-daytona-500-double-over (ESPN)]
